_metadata.description: Requirement stubs scaffolded from the P1 operational targets.

requirements.description: The system should compute a group thread's ceiling as the lowest trust tier present in its roster, so that adding a lower-tier participant narrows the room rather than widening that participant.
requirements.title: Group threads with a roster-derived ceiling

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:SWBD-P1-001] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: The system should withhold from a group thread any content that only one member's tier unlocks, and should state the withholding rather than answering partially.
requirements.title: No cross-member disclosure in a group

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:SWBD-P1-002] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: The system should stay silent in a thread with more than one human unless the agent is addressed by mention, reply, or wake word, while still recording every message to the thread.
requirements.title: Speaking discipline

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:SWBD-P1-003] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: The system should mark every agent-authored message and should never start a turn in response to one.
requirements.title: Agent-authored message loop breaker

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:SWBD-P1-004] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: The system should enforce an hourly turn budget per thread, should fail closed when it is exhausted, and should notify the owner once rather than on every suppressed turn.
requirements.title: Per-thread turn budget

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:SWBD-P1-005] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: The system should enforce a spend cap per thread so that a participant who is not the owner cannot exhaust the owner's balance, and should surface the cap to the owner.
requirements.title: Per-thread spend cap

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:SWBD-P1-006] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: The system should read a capability grant from the agent descriptor that names existing agent-manager scopes and program-runtime bindings, and should never define a second policy vocabulary.
requirements.title: Capability grant on the agent descriptor

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:SWBD-P1-007] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: The system should draft a complete agent descriptor from a plain-language description, should present it for confirmation before writing, and should write it through a typed action rather than a free-form model write.
requirements.title: Assisted agent authoring

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:SWBD-P1-008] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: The system should let an agent request a scope it lacks, should route that request to the owner only, and should expire an unanswered request rather than leaving the thread pending.
requirements.title: Approval gate with expiry

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:SWBD-P1-009] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: The system should send and receive iMessage through a Mac in the owner's fleet reached by vrooli-bridge, and should report a stated unavailable reason when no Mac is reachable.
requirements.title: iMessage adapter through a Mac fleet node

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:SWBD-P1-010] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: The system should send and receive text, images, files, and threaded replies on Slack, using the same adapter contract as every other channel.
requirements.title: Slack adapter

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:SWBD-P1-011] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: The system should evaluate each descriptor's requirements against the facts vrooli-bridge and tunnel-manager already hold, and should present an unavailable channel as a prompt to satisfy the requirement rather than as a selectable option.
requirements.title: Channel availability computed from host facts

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:SWBD-P1-012] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: The system should present available channels ordered by the setup friction each descriptor declares, so that the least-effort path is first without any maintained ordering.
requirements.title: Attach catalogue ordered by declared friction

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:SWBD-P1-013] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: The system should charge cost-bearing inference and hosted speech through landing-page-business-suite, and should fall through to an operator-supplied provider key with no charge when one is configured.
requirements.title: Metered inference through the business suite

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:SWBD-P1-014] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: The system should let notification-hub deliver one-shot notifications through the same conversational adapters, so that one channel is never implemented twice.
requirements.title: Notification hub shares the adapter registry

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:SWBD-P1-015] tag) once the behavior exists.
